source: LED Connection flood LC-FL-WS-3CCT: supplier 9th Gen flood datasheet installation pages (tools/specs/sources/LC-FL-WS-3CCT/vendor-datasheet.pdf, pages 4-7); step-down from LC's SO636 set-up note (api/shared/parts.js SETUP). Never printed.
inbox: Fits a pole or tenon up to 60 mm (2-3/8 in) diameter

warning: Only persons qualified for electrical work should carry out the electrical work.
Turn off the power supply before installation, and cut it off at once in any abnormal situation.
Be sure to ground the fixture.
The fixture runs on 120-277V only. Never connect it directly to a 480V circuit.
Do not wipe the fixture with water or caustic solution, and avoid high pressure.
Be careful when handling and storing the fixture.
common.electrical: Supply the fixture with the voltage on its label (120-277V AC). On a 480V circuit it must be fed through the 480V-to-277V step-down transformer: see the last section of this guide.
common.grounding: Connect the green wire to the ground of the supply, in accordance with the NEC and local codes.
before: Ensure that the supply power is shut off.
Unpack the fixture and check that nothing is damaged or missing.
Check the part number on the label: -Y is the yoke bracket, -SF the slip-fitter.

steps.title: Before mounting, set the wattage and CCT. Lay the fixture face down and unscrew the selector cover on the back with a cross (Phillips) screwdriver.
Take out the cover and put it aside.
Turn the POWER and CCT selectors to the setting the design calls for.
Screw the cover back into the fixture.
Loosen the screw that holds the upper and lower mount at the pivot, with the hexagon wrench.
Rotate the bracket to the angle the design calls for (0 to 90 degrees).
Lock the upper and lower brackets with the hexagon wrench.
Connect the wires: black to line (L), white to neutral (N), green to ground. For 0-10V dimming, purple to DIM+ and pink to DIM-. Cap the dimming wires if they are not used.
Fix the slip-fitter on the pole with the hexagon wrench. The pole can be up to 60 mm (2-3/8 in) in diameter.

sections.title: 480V circuit: the step-down transformer
sections.intro: This flood runs on 120-277V. Where the circuit is 480V, a 480V-to-277V step-down transformer feeds it. On Kroger 345 it ships with the flood and sits in the flood's junction box.
lines: Mount the transformer in the junction box before connecting the flood.
Connect the transformer's 480V input to the supply circuit and its 277V output to the flood's black (L) and white (N) wires; green to ground.
Use the wiring diagram printed on the transformer's own label for its lead colours and taps. They are not repeated here because they differ between transformer models.
Check the label's input voltage against the circuit before switching on.

box.title: NEVER
lines: Never connect the flood straight to 480V. It is rated 120-277V and will be damaged.

record_note: Anything not as designed (mounting, height, aim, setting): write it in the pin's note.
